summary: The Chautautauqa-Cattaraugus Library System emphasizes the importance of preserving the E-Rate program to maintain affordable internet access for public libraries in rural communities. They highlight the financial burden of operating libraries on residential internet connections and the need to preserve the core program to ensure continued access to high-quality internet services. The comment supports preserving the core E-Rate program and ensuring access to affordable broadband for libraries, while opposing any changes that could reduce access or increase administrative burden.

claims.argument: Preserving the core program would maintain essential connectivity services
